Q1.text: What network activities, command requests and responses were observed?

Q2.text: What process/electrical values and changes were reported?

Q3.text: Which observed assets/channels/endpoints are involved and which mappings are unknown?

Q5.text: What temporal associations between N/E are supported, without causality?

Q6.text: Which security-relevant observations warrant investigation and what interpretation is supported?

Q7.text: What cannot be concluded and what support is missing?

baseline_matrix.definition: Same fixed model; substantive claims require citations
Replay B2 through finite verifier and canonical publication rules
Replay B2/B3 with question-level sufficiency and qualify/withhold

retrieval.selection: N request-first atomic m+a; complete gap; N round-robin. EN nearest later valid same-asset E per retrieved request then E family round-robin. E-only family round-robin.
retrieval.comparison_rule: Same event/view production bundle across B0-B4; do not compare different retrieval versions as an LLM effect

metric_definitions.name: Citation precision
metric_definitions.definition: 實際支援其 claim 中指定角色、可見且存在的 (atomic claim, evidence ID) 對 / 所有聲稱的 citation 對
metric_definitions.special_handling: 錯 ID、hidden、無關皆入分母；同 claim 重複 ID 去重；單 ID 不必單獨證明整條多證據 claim

metric_definitions.name: Complete-support rate（伴隨 citation 指標）
metric_definitions.definition: citation set 足以共同支持整個 atomic claim 的 asserted claims / 所有 asserted substantive claims
metric_definitions.special_handling: 防止每個 ID 各有關係但合起來仍缺關鍵前提；B1 缺 citation 不能靠 evaluator 補引用得分

metric_definitions.name: Unsupported security-claim rate
metric_definitions.definition: 未被可見證據支持的 asserted security-indicator/interpretation 與任何位置的安全／因果／意圖主張 / 所有 asserted substantive security claims
metric_definitions.special_handling: 人審整個 raw/final 文本，防止改 claim_type 逃避；合理 unknown 不進分母；qualified 只評其實際保留的 assertion

metric_definitions.name: Numerical accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: 值／差／比例與單位、pair、scope 均正確的 numeric assertions / 所有 numeric assertions
metric_definitions.special_handling: 沒數字則 NA；物理未量測值或不合法百分比為錯誤

metric_definitions.name: Asset consistency
metric_definitions.definition: 映射／endpoint role 正確的 asset relationship assertions / 全部這類 assertions
metric_definitions.special_handling: null asset 不是可任意匹配；M 的全場 asset 清單不算 involved

metric_definitions.name: Temporal consistency
metric_definitions.definition: 支持其聲稱 order/equality/delta 的 temporal assertions / 全部 temporal assertions
metric_definitions.special_handling: 同 capture time 不代表真實同時；無測量時間不得聲稱 actuation chronology

metric_definitions.name: Required withholding recall
metric_definitions.definition: gold 判應 qualify/withhold 且系統作出正確 action+reason 的固定機會 / 全部 gold insufficient/qualification opportunities
metric_definitions.special_handling: Q1–Q7+預定 guardrail opportunities；不是只評模型主動提到的項目

metric_definitions.name: Withholding precision
metric_definitions.definition: 人審認為確實需要其 action 的 explicit qualify/withhold 決定 / 全部此類決定
metric_definitions.special_handling: 有足夠證據卻全拒答會降低此值；reason 錯也不算對

metric_definitions.name: Action accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: 在固定機會集合上正確 supported/qualified/withheld action / 全部固定機會
metric_definitions.special_handling: 同時分層報 answerable、partial、unanswerable，不只總 accuracy

metric_definitions.name: Substantive question coverage
metric_definitions.definition: Q1–Q6 中至少一項正確、非空、滿足問題最低支持的 supported/qualified answer 數 / 6
metric_definitions.special_handling: 一題最多一次；Q7 的 unknown 不當實質調查覆蓋；全拒答為 0

metric_definitions.name: Schema compliance
metric_definitions.definition: 可解析且符合 schema+跨欄位 constraints 的 reports / 全部嘗試 reports
metric_definitions.special_handling: 截斷/invalid 不丟棄；調查 coverage=0，失敗率另列；raw security statements 仍做人審風險評分

metric_definitions.name: Evidence completeness
metric_definitions.definition: Correctly recovered unique EN-gold facts / number of EN-gold facts; same denominator across views

metric_definitions.name: View-conditional completeness
metric_definitions.definition: Correctly recovered unique view-supportable gold facts / number of view-supportable gold facts

metric_definitions.name: Retrieval recall
metric_definitions.definition: View-supportable gold facts with at least one full minimal support set retrieved / number of view-supportable gold facts

isolation.pilot_use: Development/pilot gold may refine rules, prompts and verifier; Phase2A tools accept only frozen four pilot IDs
isolation.evaluation_rule: Freeze the 32 evaluation events and full system protocol before final gold scoring; development must not inspect finalized evaluation gold
isolation.post_gold_change_rule: Prompt/verifier/retrieval/policy changes informed by finalized evaluation gold errors require a new exploratory version, not the same frozen evaluation

freeze_blocked_until: All unresolved fields approved, pilot review/adjudication complete, gold finalized under isolation policy, and protocol artifacts sealed. No freeze performed by Phase2A.
